race.comment: BEST TERMS (1) has the most reliable profile, with six placings from seven starts and two placings from two visits to this track. He was below market expectation as odds-on favourite at Horsham, tiring into third after travelling well but will strip fitter and finds the right race to break through. BELLE FLAMME (8) is the main danger if she recaptures her Donald placing, unsuited at Bendigo last time. Now third up and drawn the inside, she can improve. URBAN CREED (6) resumes after five months and has had three trials, including a latest third at Cranbourne. Should be ready to run well. PNEUMA (4) is the race-fit closer in the mix, having fought hard when beaten half a length at Moe after an improved Geelong run at big odds. Should be thereabouts again. MARCO POLO (3) was solid fresh at Geelong and can improve up in trip.
